chunk: Tanya Little was born on February 3, 2005, in Arizona. Growing up, she was fascinated by the world of makeup and art, often spending hours watching YouTube tutorials and practicing her skills on friends and family. Her parents, though initially skeptical, soon realized her passion and encouraged her to pursue it.
Tanya's early education was unconventional, with her parents homeschooling her and allowing her to focus on her artistic interests. She spent most of her free time honing her makeup skills
